// diagnostic

E0076

This result loop has a missing or incompatible break payload.

What

This result loop has a missing or incompatible break payload.

Why

An ordinary loop used as a value has one final result type. Every exit that targets it must provide that type.

Fix

add the missing payload and make every payload the same type, or target an inner effect-only loop.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0076: tests/ui/result_loop_break_payloads.stderr.

 Why: every exit from a loop used as a value must provide the same result type
 Fix: add a break payload, or target an inner effect-only loop
